bad_origin: This address isn't allowed. Open the page from the server's own address.
bad_request: The server couldn't read that request.
rate_limited: Too many tries. Wait a moment, then try again.
login_locked: Too many wrong PINs. Login is locked for a few minutes.
pin_exists: A PIN is already set. Log in with it.
bad_setup_token: Wrong setup code. You'll find it in the server log.
pairing_closed: Pairing is closed. Open the pairing window first.
pairing_full: Too many screens are waiting. Approve or reject some first.
unknown_code: No screen is waiting with that code.
unknown_device: That screen isn't paired any more.
unknown_phone: That camera phone isn't known any more.
slot_empty: No camera is assigned to that slot.
bad_host: Enter the phone's local IP address, like 192.168.11.57.
endpoint_taken: Another camera already uses that address.
cam_busy: Another app is using this camera. Close it on the phone.
cam_releasing: Waiting for the phone to free its previous stream…
cam_http: The phone gave an unexpected answer.
cam_bad_stream: The phone's video stream is broken.
torch_unknown: The flashlight state is unknown. Test or fix it on the camera card.
